quarterly_data.signal: September 2026 consolidated revenue of NT$344.2 hundred million, a 54-month high, up NT$38.2 hundred million (volume +20.0, price +18.2) or 12.5% from August 2026, mainly driven by electronic materials and chemical products; versus September 2025 revenue rose NT$122.5 hundred million (volume +39.0, price +83.5), or 55.3%, with electronic materials playing the most critical role. Electronic materials revenue grew 8.5% from August and 90.1% from a year earlier.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nan Ya Plastics MOPS material information: release 1303-20261012-1 (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company: the industry is expanding AI compute at extremely high speed and hyperscale facility build-outs are driving a rapid rise in demand for copper clad laminate, circuit boards, copper foil and glass fabric; under high-speed transmission and ultra-low-loss requirements material specifications are upgrading at an unprecedented pace, and even though suppliers have shifted much low- and mid-end capacity to high-end materials, supply volumes and lead times still cannot meet overall demand, so materials are extremely short and price increases have spread from high-end to all materials. The whole PCB chain - glass fabric (yarn), copper foil, high-end electronic resins, CCL and IC substrates - is in short supply; Nan Ya's orders are fully loaded and utilization of each electronic-materials product is close to full load. Besides raising prices with the market, it is lifting output through process optimisation and co-developing special glass fiber, high-frequency high-speed copper foil, advanced resins and high-end CCL to reach optimal material formulations and enter supply chains in time. Electronic materials revenue rose NT$15.5 hundred million from August (volume +6.7, price +8.8) and NT$94.1 hundred million from a year earlier (volume +41.8, price +52.3).
